notes: Random control, end and start points (small, screen-sized and full-range signed words) and shifts whose low five bits are 0..8, or 15, 16, 19, 22, 26, 27 or 31 where the 32-bit step count goes negative or zero (random upper bits; the original uses only the low byte, and CL masks it). 0xc8c78 logs ESI and ECX and clobbers every register including EBP; the point list at 0x15957c is compared as RAM.
